en.headline: Tsim Sha Tsui Cultural Centre piazza lights up for Mid-Autumn
en.dek: A free night-time lantern installation on Salisbury Road is scheduled to glow from 6.30pm to 11pm until 11 October, running alongside the Victoria Park carnival.
body: A Mid-Autumn lighting installation is now on at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre Piazza in Tsim Sha Tsui, giving the harbourfront a second official lantern site besides Victoria Park.

The Leisure and Cultural Services Department and the Hong Kong Tourism Board list the display from 17 September to 11 October. Lanterns are scheduled to light from 6.30pm to 11pm each night, extending to midnight on 25 September, the Mid-Autumn Festival. Admission is free.

The department is also staging the Mid-Autumn Lantern Carnival at Victoria Park from 17 to 27 September, with traditional crafts and performances. On 27 September, the Cultural Centre foyer is scheduled to host an inclusive performance by disabled artists from 3pm to 4pm. Visitors heading to Tsim Sha Tsui can reach the piazza on foot from Tsim Sha Tsui MTR station or along Salisbury Road.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀文化中心廣場中秋光影裝置亮燈
zh.dek: 康文署及旅發局在梵士巴利道香港文化中心廣場設置免費綵燈裝置，9月17日至10月11日每晚6時30分至11時亮燈。
body: 尖沙咀香港文化中心廣場的中秋光影裝置已經亮燈，與維園綵燈會分開，為維港海濱再添一處官方賞燈點。
康樂及文化事務署及香港旅遊發展局列出的展期為9月17日至10月11日，每晚下午6時30分至11時亮燈，中秋節當日（9月25日）延長至午夜12時，免費入場。
康文署同期於9月17日至27日在維多利亞公園舉行中秋綵燈會，並設傳統工藝及表演。9月27日下午3時至4時，文化中心大堂將舉行共融演出，由殘疾表演者演出。市民可由港鐵尖沙咀站或沿梵士巴利道步行前往廣場。
